required_behavior: Open-sky multi-satellite input returns finite HPL/VPL and valid 3x3 position FIM
Missing epoch returns explicit fallback reason
Too few satellites returns explicit fallback reason
Excluded satellites reduce used count and return explicit fallback when below min_sats
Map occlusion/skymask changes visible satellite count and degrades PDOP/HPL/VPL
Clock Schur complement output is symmetric, finite, and PSD or explicitly rejected
Feature-rich 3D primitives return valid FIM with nonzero primitive count
Sparse/corridor/planar-degenerate geometry returns fallback or regularization diagnostics
Missing normals/primitives returns explicit fallback reason
lidar_enable_legacy_observability=false prevents legacy observability from masking FIM failure
GNSS-only, LiDAR-only, and fused outputs are separately explainable
Missing/invalid prior does not block valid GNSS or LiDAR advisory sources
No advisory source returns unavailable with combined fallback reason
